format.description: The pack format this app reads.

id.description: Names this pack's storage and locks in the browser, so two packs opened from disk never share sessions. Default: a hash of the sorted role ids, written into the build.

theme.description: The brand theme in theme/*.css: { "id", "name" }. Its id is written onto <html data-theme>.

allowResumeToTypeSafe.description: true lets npm run suggest send a resume to TypeSafe to rank pools.

unrankedPools.description: Pools npm run suggest never ranks, such as behavioral ones a resume says nothing about.

a11yExclude.description: Selectors whose low contrast the pack theme accepts; npm run a11y skips color contrast on them.

plugins.description: false leaves a plugin out of the built file. Names are folders under src/plugins/; check rejects an unknown one. The CLI's --without wins over this.

url.description: Where this pack's built file is served. When set, Invite makes a link and a QR code to it.

sync.description: turn: TURN servers for the sync plugin; relays: relay URLs in place of the default list.

turn.description: TURN servers, tried after a direct path. Without one, data stays on the meeting point, which is slower. Credentials here end up in the built file.

relays.description: Replaces the default meeting points (public WebSocket relays). check notes a list with no relay on port 443, since many corporate networks allow nothing else.

lint.description: avoidVerbs: more opening verbs that get a note; allowVerbs: verbs accepted at the levels named.

avoidVerbs.description: Extra opening verbs the observable-wording note flags.

allowVerbs.description: Opening verbs accepted at one level only, keyed by level id or name: { "l5": ["leads"] }.

retentionDays.description: Days after the last change before a decided session is deleted from this laptop. An undecided session is never deleted without a warning.
